milestoneAPIStatus: Nine milestones created through the official GitHub interface; all nine issues assigned through the GitHub connector.

requirements.title: Traceability and approved roadmap
requirements.acceptance: Every requirement has status, issue, milestone intent, acceptance criteria, tests and evidence; preserve historical plans and private archives.

requirements.title: Safe, recoverable operations
requirements.acceptance: Unreadable shell files are preserved; all mutations share a lease; incomplete measurement is explicit; durable checkpoints and guided recovery survive injected failures.
externalDependencies: Physical power-loss/cable-removal and another Mac remain unverified.

requirements.title: Complete scoped disk explorer
requirements.acceptance: A private paginated SQLite index finds items beyond the old display limits; full-scope search and bounded navigation report incomplete coverage honestly.
externalDependencies: Resource results need confirmation on additional Macs/filesystems.

requirements.title: Verified personal-file actions
requirements.acceptance: Disposable files/folders retain data and metadata; conflicts, space, cloud data and interruption are checked; source is recoverable via verified copy or Trash.
externalDependencies: Additional Macs/devices/filesystems and physical cable/power faults remain unverified.

requirements.title: Qualified cache and SSD workflows
requirements.acceptance: Seven versioned adapters describe effective routing and qualification. Disposable real installs/builds, SSD absent and documented offline scenarios pass. Bun/uv origins stay local.
externalDependencies: pip requires an offline wheelhouse for empty-cache installation; Homebrew/CocoaPods offline network isolation remains unverified.

requirements.title: Opt-in growth tracking
requirements.acceptance: Comparable snapshots and advisory filesystem events show growth; absent disks and lost permission are not reported as recovered space; retention is bounded.
externalDependencies: Real seven-day use and notification frequency are beta evidence, not simulated-time test results.

requirements.title: Portuguese/English and accessible public UX
requirements.acceptance: Both audiences can navigate core flows with keyboard/VoiceOver, choose languages and understand permissions, consequences, recovery and incomplete state.
externalDependencies: Full hands-on VoiceOver acceptance and additional users/Macs pending.

requirements.title: Verified distribution and consented updates
requirements.acceptance: Internal installation remains usable without SSD; production requires Developer ID/notarization; signed Sparkle updates and removal preserve configuration. No signing keys in Git.
externalDependencies: Developer ID Application identity and notarization profile unavailable.
Hosted signed appcast and end-to-end valid/invalid signed update checks pending.
